noveltyJustification: Seven findings are new MCP schema and control facts; one corrects the Angle 6 package-availability claim, and one confirms the generated tool-name shape.
answeredQuestions: How are MCP servers configured, and can this repo's servers and code-mode connect?

label: One dsh-mcp-client row per server takes serverName and transport stdio|streamable-http, then command/args/env/cwd or url/headers, with toolCallTimeoutMs 60s default, optional startupTimeoutMs, closeTimeoutMs, expandTemplates and failOnStartupError.

MCP tools are exposed as mcp__<serverName>__<rawName> with the namespace from local configuration, so restarts and upgrades do not rename model-facing tools and same-named tools coexist under different namespaces.

Server instructions join the logged system prompt as literal text up to 32,768 bytes and MCP prompt templates are unsupported, so server instructions are untrusted prompt input under the same data-not-instructions rule as fetched pages.
MCP configuration lives only in the active profile's cordis.patch.yml or a --patch overlay; there is no project MCP file, so .pi/mcp.json must be translated into one .dsh/mcp.yml row per server.

The stdio bridge scrubs credential-like ambient variables and every DSH_* variable before launching the child, so a server's needs must be named in the row env; expandTemplates adds credential:REF resolution but requires a credentials provider that headless disables.

The code-mode entry translates directly to a stdio row running node .skilled/bin/mcp-code-mode-launcher.cjs with UTCP_CONFIG_FILE and cwd at the repo root; its lifecycle lazy key has no harness equivalent and becomes an eager connection bounded by startupTimeoutMs.

Per-dispatch MCP control is composition-only: a dispatch that omits the rows has no MCP tools, one that passes a patch gets exactly those servers, and the live mcp-manager fleet exists only in web/desktop profiles.

dsh-mcp-client is bundled inside the installed 0.2.2-rc.1 package while dsh-hooks-claude-code is not bundled, so MCP needs only a profile row and the Claude hook bridge needs an install step, correcting the Angle 6 shipped wording.
Base mounts mcp-resources but not mcp-client, so a headless dispatch has no MCP tool until a patch adds a server row, and the mcp__.* route-guard matcher shape still fits once rewritten as a regex.

reason: The harness has no project MCP config scan; the file must be translated to Cordis rows.
No such flags exist; server availability is decided by the composed patch.
The harness client has no lifecycle field and connects with the plugin lifecycle.
